summary: Learn omnichannel customer experience management with journey maps, CX metrics, and service recovery tools. Build practical improvement plans in 5 days.
lede: Managing customer experience across channels involves connecting journeys, customer context, and service operations across digital and assisted touchpoints. For professionals working in customer service, CRM, digital channels, or experience reporting, the course develops practical skills in journey diagnostics, channel performance measurement, service blueprinting, and improving handoffs between channels.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with customer service, CRM, digital channels, or experience reporting and now need a structured omnichannel customer experience management approach.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, stable internet access, and the ability to review sample journey maps, CRM exports, and CX dashboards. Bring one real omnichannel issue from your work, such as repeated complaints, broken handoffs, or inconsistent service across channels.
